task: Unicode transformation toolkit ae.utf with chunk-invariant streaming UTF-8 decoder and Punycode
reasoning_summary: Implemented the WHATWG UTF-8 state machine once and used it for strict (offset of sequence start), lossy (maximal subpart) and streaming modes; chunking invariance is tested with random splits. UTF-16 and RFC 3492 Punycode were verified against published vectors, JDK charsets and java.net.IDN. A 18-mutant pass found three test gaps (offset reset, high surrogate upper bound, surrogate result) which were closed.
